meta.title: Hartwall Long Drink — Coming Soon to Nepal | Nordic Spirits Trade
meta.description: Finland's iconic Hartwall Original Long Drink is arriving in Nepal. Six vibrant flavours of the Nordic classic — distributed by Nordic Spirits Trade.

hero.tagline: Same authentic taste. A new horizon.
hero.body: Hartwall Original Long Drink — the iconic Finnish ready-to-drink beverage — is coming to Nepal. Six vibrant flavours, one legendary spirit.

brand.heading: Born at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
brand.body1: What started as a refreshing drink for the Olympic Games became a Finnish icon. Today, Hartwall Original Long Drink is enjoyed around the world — and now it's ready for Nepal's premium market.
brand.body2: Made with real gin and natural grapefruit soda, it's light, balanced, and unmistakably Nordic — the perfect introduction of Finnish drinking culture to a new generation of Nepali consumers.
brand.featureStoryDesc: From Olympic spirit to global favourite.

flavours.tapHint: Tap a flavour card to reveal tasting notes

gingrapefruit.name: Gin & Grapefruit
gingrapefruit.subtitle: The Original
gingrapefruit.note: Crisp Finnish gin balanced with zesty grapefruit soda. The one that started it all — light, refreshing, unmistakably Nordic.

raspberry.name: Gin & Raspberry
raspberry.subtitle: Fruity Twist
raspberry.note: Vibrant raspberry meets premium gin. Sweet, tart, and wonderfully refreshing — a bold twist on the classic.

lemonade.name: Gin & Lemon
lemonade.subtitle: Zesty & Fresh
lemonade.note: Bright lemon soda meets Nordic gin. Tangy, light, and full of sunshine character — perfect for warm Nepali evenings.

orange.name: Gin & Orange
orange.subtitle: Citrus Classic
orange.note: Sun-kissed orange and premium gin in perfect balance. Warm, smooth, and endlessly drinkable.

pineapple.name: Gin & Pineapple
pineapple.subtitle: Tropical Escape
pineapple.note: A tropical spin on the Nordic classic. Sweet pineapple with a clean gin backbone — adventurous and refreshing.

glogg.name: Glögg Special
glogg.subtitle: Winter Edition
glogg.note: A Nordic seasonal expression. Warm spiced notes with a long drink twist — Finland's winter spirit in a can.

nepal.heading: A growing premium beverage market.
nepal.body: With a thriving tourism industry, an increasing demand for international brands, and a young, urban consumer base, Nepal is the perfect next destination for Hartwall Original Long Drink.
nepal.ctaBody: We are looking for the right distribution partners in Nepal to bring this Finnish icon to life. From rooftop bars in Thamel to luxury lodges in Pokhara — the opportunity is here.

partner.heading: Same Spirit. A New Home.
partner.body: Nepal is a land of breathtaking mountains, rich culture, and warm people — and it's time for a new kind of refreshment. Hartwall Long Drink brings a taste of Finland to the heart of Nepal, for those who seek something different, premium, and truly refreshing.
partner.cardEyebrow: Be Part of the Nepal Journey
partner.cardHeading: Building a premium Nordic beverage brand in Nepal.
partner.cardBody: We'd love for you to be part of it. We are actively seeking distribution partners, importers, and on-trade accounts across Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan, and beyond.

whyNepal.heroHeading:
Nepal: Where Adventure
Meets the New
Global Lifestyle
whyNepal.heroBody: Nepal is evolving beyond its traditional identity as an adventure destination. A new generation of travellers, premium hospitality experiences and internationally recognised nightlife are creating a market where global brands can connect with curious, experience-driven consumers.
whyNepal.s1Body: Shinta Mani Mustang was named the world's No. 1 luxury hotel in Robb Report's 2026 ranking of the 50 Greatest Luxury Hotels on Earth — based on recommendations from 24 leading luxury travel specialists.
whyNepal.s1Connect: Nepal is gaining recognition not only for adventure, but for world-class luxury, hospitality and curated experiences. That shift creates new opportunities for premium international brands to become part of Nepal's evolving lifestyle culture.
whyNepal.s2Heading: LOD — Lord of the Drinks, Kathmandu
whyNepal.s2Body: LOD Kathmandu has been ranked #40 in DJ Mag's 2026 Top 100 Clubs, climbing from #44 in 2025. More than 500 clubs participated in this year's global competition — placing Kathmandu firmly on the world's nightlife map.
whyNepal.s2Connect: From the Himalayas to the dance floor, Nepal is developing a nightlife culture with international visibility. For Hartwall, this creates more than a distribution opportunity — it creates a platform for experiences, music, social occasions and a new generation of internationally minded consumers.
whyNepal.s3Heading:
Nepal Offers More
Than a Destination
whyNepal.s3Tagline: Visitors come to Nepal for the mountains. They stay for the experiences.
whyNepal.s3Body: Nepal brings together adventure tourism, international travellers, hospitality, culture, nightlife and increasingly sophisticated premium experiences in one distinctive destination. This is not simply another beverage market — it is an experience-driven environment where a brand can build a story.
whyNepal.s4Heading:
A Market to Test.
A Story to Scale.
whyNepal.s4Body: Nepal offers Hartwall an opportunity to introduce Original Long Drink in a market where international tourism, premium hospitality and emerging nightlife culture intersect.
whyNepal.pillar1Body: A distinctive product entering an emerging market can create genuine curiosity and strong word-of-mouth among internationally minded consumers.
whyNepal.pillar2Body: Hartwall can be positioned around social occasions, nightlife, travel and memorable experiences — rather than competing purely on price.
whyNepal.pillar3Body: Nepal's international tourism ecosystem creates opportunities for visitors to experience the brand and carry awareness well beyond the local market.
whyNepal.finalHeading:
Nepal Is Ready
for Something New.
whyNepal.finalBody: Nepal is gaining a new kind of international recognition — from the world's best luxury hospitality to globally ranked nightlife. For Hartwall Original Long Drink, that creates an opportunity to enter Nepal not simply as another beverage, but as part of a modern, social and internationally connected lifestyle.
whyNepal.finalTagline2: A new market. A new experience. A story worth testing.
